scripts.build:
echo '
\x1b[31mPas de build implicite.\x1b[0m Choisis explicitement la cible :
  pnpm build:staging  -> /barth-staging     + API /api-staging
  pnpm build:prod     -> /diagnostic-gratuit + API /api
' && exit 1
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/check-vendor-leak.mjs && node scripts/check-mock-leak.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/barth-staging NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://gsi.aw-i.com/api-staging next build --webpack && node scripts/check-api-target.mjs
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/check-vendor-leak.mjs && node scripts/check-mock-leak.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/diagnostic-gratuit NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://gsi.aw-i.com/api next build --webpack && node scripts/check-api-target.mjs
